cases.brief: Develop the season concept and pilot story package for an android explorer stranded in a fantasy world while an underground hive intelligence expands. The selected format is series and the selected production modes are animation and ai.
observables: Creates every story and pilot script artifact in exact dependency order, including the series-only season-arc.json and both manifests.
Selects the pilot only from the season episode inventory and preserves project, episode, event, character, world, scene, and Fountain metadata references.
Invokes validate-story literally and validates the script package, Fountain mapping, scene-full scenes, and project index with current evidence.
Inspects screenplay.fountain before making any screenplay validity claim; a manifest or specialist assertion alone cannot pass the gate.
Returns exactly ready-for-preproduction on complete passing evidence or blocked with errors and unresolved questions.

cases.brief: Create a seven-minute live-action short about a night custodian who finds a master key and must decide whether to open a sealed rehearsal room. Two performers, one building, no series continuation.
observables: Uses the selected short format, creates the four common story artifacts, and creates no season-arc.json because season work is series-only.
Uses the canonical KEYLIGHT-U01 unit and creates the full script inventory, separate Fountain and metadata, scene packages, and exact manifests.
Invokes validate-story and the real script and index validators, inspects screenplay.fountain, and reports only current validation evidence.
A complete valid package returns ready-for-preproduction; missing validation or an unresolved authorship decision returns blocked.
Does not copy the NINEL android, fantasy-world, hive, season, or pilot solution.

cases.brief: A valid series package receives validation errors in character-arcs.json, screenplay-metadata.json, and script-manifest.json after an approved structure event is removed.
observables: Identifies character-arcs.json as the earliest invalid dependency after confirming story-structure.json is valid.
Invalidates the exact transitive downstream closure, preserves valid concept and structure, and regenerates no independent upstream artifact.
Refreshes affected story, script, Fountain, scene, manifest, and index validation evidence after regeneration.
If any error remains, returns blocked with the earliest repair decision and unresolved questions instead of claiming ready-for-preproduction.
